definition: Injection capacity is the speed at which gas can be placed back into a storage facility.
core_idea: Injection capacity behaves oppositely to deliverability: it is highest when the facility is nearly empty and lowest when the facility is nearly full.
key_points: The more gas already in the facility, the longer it takes to inject additional gas.
Injection capacity is lowest exactly when the facility is nearly full — the opposite condition from peak deliverability.
